_what: BASE-01 Plan 02.1-01 Task 1 — exact decoded column casing of quickswap_v3_polygon.algebrapool_evt_{mint,burn,collect}, pinned from a LIVE Dune LIMIT-2 sample (orchestrator-side via the Dune MCP) BEFORE the L_K query text is sha256-locked (RESEARCH Open Question 1 / Pitfall 5).
note_casing: Decoded columns are camelCase (bottomTick, topTick, liquidityAmount) — NOT the lowercase the RESEARCH assumed. DuneSQL identifiers are case-insensitive unquoted, but record the true casing. collect has NO liquidityAmount: its amount0/amount1 are the WITHDRAWN FEES (the independent Υ referent).

burn.sign_convention: burn REMOVES liquidity: liquidityNet contribution is -liquidityAmount at bottomTick, +liquidityAmount at topTick (mirror of mint)

collect.note: Collect = LP fee/principal withdrawal. amount0/amount1 are the realized withdrawn amounts — usable as part of the INDEPENDENT Υ referent (disjoint from the swap-side Σ φ_X·Δ_X·⟨L_K,μ⟩).

L_K_reconstruction_casing.net_liquidity_per_tick: SUM over mint(+liquidityAmount@bottomTick, -liquidityAmount@topTick) UNION burn(-liquidityAmount@bottomTick, +liquidityAmount@topTick) ... then cumsum(liquidityNet) OVER (ORDER BY tick) = active liquidity L_K(i)
L_K_reconstruction_casing.cross_check: cumsum at the pool's current tick MUST equal pool.liquidity() at the snapshot block (archive eth_call)
